risk_note: RV2 (union; order ownership path). D10-776: the archive (union_raw_payloads) of 大淘客 Taobao order-details requests stores the page with other companies' promotion-slot rows removed (changelog 20261031 §1 row 24 「不入库别家订单」). UnionTransportRequest gains an optional archiveBody rewrite function, separate from ArchiveContext; createArchivingTransport stores the gzip of the rewritten body (content_hash of what is stored); taobaoOrderArchiveBody drops only rows whose slot is readable and not ours (same taobaoOrderAdzone reading as ourRows), keeps unreadable rows and all outer fields, keeps number literals verbatim (reviver context.source); a body that is not JSON stores an empty payload with error_code (the upstream code first, else archive_body_rewrite_failed) and still inserts; success sets no error_code; failure log carries only event/platform/kind/error_name. Refund, punishment, search and convert requests pass no rewrite function (archive unchanged). The foreign-slot warning stays one per page from ourRows. No amount change.

reviews.note: Codex usage exhausted until 11-11 (D10-775): money review by a fresh independent Claude via tools/agent/claude-run.sh, round 1 pass; plus a separate fresh read-only re-check (D10-775) CONFIRMED with no S0/S1 and three S2 recorded as FU-TB-ARCHIVE-EDGE (duplicate JSON keys and a non-array publisher_order_dto could keep a foreign row in the archive; a non-2xx HTML error page is now stored empty).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests (test/spec/union/taobao-order-archive/) by fresh independent Claude contexts in 2 counted attempts (the 2nd only turned a property's boolean result into expect), 18 tests in 6 files red at the base; round 1 pass with three S2 (no error_code on success, no body in the failure log, empty windows are not failures), all handled in the implementation.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
